items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I knew him before he was playing violin. He used to play violin with my daddy, Freddie. Freddie Keppard and Louis Keppard is around.

ctx.x: They call that the Cats and Jammer. That's right, Cats and Jammer. The Parkland Cocktails. That's nice. Well I was going to ask about Freddie Keppard, if you could tell a little bit more about him. You knew him when he first started then?
Well, on the air, I knew him before he was playing violin. He used to play violin with my daddy, Freddie. Freddie Keppard and Louis Keppard is around.

Yeah, he's still here. I know him quite well. Well, yeah. I never did get to meet his brother. I have some of his records, Freddie's records. Never met Louis? Oh, Louis, I know. But not Freddie. Freddie died before I got...
